stories.h: First Likud–Yashar unity talks end without progress
stories.s: Negotiators met for about an hour Sunday but neither Eisenkot nor Netanyahu will cede the premiership. Netanyahu's camp reportedly signaled it could drop Ben Gvir's party; talks continue.

stories.h: Police probe Election Day arrests linked to Netanyahu's office
stories.s: The police chief ordered an internal review after reports that a tip from the PM's office sparked pre-vote arrests of Bedouin men over alleged Ra'am vote-buying. The AG's office is also examining it.

stories.h: Third US carrier reaches Mideast as Iran bars nuclear inspections
stories.s: The USS Theodore Roosevelt arrived Sunday as Tehran refused IAEA access to damaged sites. Netanyahu still favors new strikes, while Trump reportedly may hold off absent fresh provocations.

stories.h: Israel strikes Hezbollah arms shipment in Lebanon's Beqaa
stories.s: The air force hit weapons moved from Syria near Janta overnight, the first Beqaa strike in months, as US envoy Mike Waltz visited Beirut urging Hezbollah to disarm.

stories.h: Liberman heads Knesset defense panel, opens Haredi draft debate
stories.s: Elected chair of the interim Foreign Affairs and Defense Committee, Liberman said a new conscription bill would be discussed Monday but would not be a universal draft law.

coming.h: Knesset votes to replace Speaker Ohana
coming.s: Eisenkot's bloc plans a vote to replace Likud's Amir Ohana with Yashar's Matan Kahana as Knesset speaker.

coming.h: Knesset takes up judicial overhaul repeal bills
coming.s: Eisenkot's bloc has slated legislation repealing the judicial overhaul laws for Wednesday, prioritizing it over an October 7 inquiry bill.
